description:
We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.
 
 
 
 Position Summary 
 Staff Software Development Engineer to lead the design and delivery of Provider facing scalable, high-impact software solutions supporting enterprise healthcare platforms. This role will serve as a technical leader and hands-on contributor, driving results, engineering excellence, and cross-team execution across critical initiatives.
 This position is ideal for a senior engineer who can operate independently, influence across teams, and deliver complex solutions aligned to business outcomes.
 
 Required Qualifications 
 Minimum of 7+ years of software engineering experience delivering enterprise-scale, full-stack applications across industries with demonstrated practical experience in healthcare, preferably working with Provider focused initiatives
 Proven expertise in full-stack development, including: 
 Backend: Java/J2EE, Spring Boot, Node.js
 Frontend: React, Angular, TypeScript-based frameworks
 API integration and design using REST, GraphQL, and microservices-based architecture
 5+ years of experience designing and implementing scalable distributed systems and microservices architectures, including modernization of legacy applications into cloud-native services
 3+ years of experience with the ability to design and implement secure, high-availability application architectures
 3+ years of experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices, including tools such as Jenkins, Git workflows, and infrastructure-as-code for automated deployments
 3+ years of experience with leading complex technical initiatives and cross-functional collaboration, including translating business requirements into scalable technical solutions
 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience mentoring engineers, conducting code reviews, and driving engineering best practices and standards across teams
 Strong proficiency in database design and data management, including relational and NoSQL technologies (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL, Cassandra, MongoDB)
 Experience working in Agile environments, contributing to sprint planning, design discussions, and iterative delivery of high-quality software
 Hands-on exposure to event-driven architecture and messaging systems (e.g., SNS, SQS) for real-time, distributed processing
 Exposure to accessibility standards (WCAG) and building inclusive, compliant user experiences
 Excellent problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder collaboration skills, with the ability to operate independently and influence across teams
 
 Education 
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field or equivalent practical experience.
 Post Grad Preferred
 
 
 
 
 
 Pay Range 
 The typical pay range for this role is:
 
$106,605.00 - $260,590.00 
This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls.  The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors.  This position is eligible for a CVS Health bonus, commission or short-term incentive program in addition to the base pay range listed above.  This position also includes an award target in the company’s equity award program. 
 
 Our people fuel our future. Our teams reflect the customers, patients, members and communities we serve and we are committed to fostering a workplace where every colleague feels valued and that they belong.
 
 Great benefits for great people 
 
 We take pride in offering a comprehensive and competitive mix of pay and benefits that reflects our commitment to our colleagues and their families.


This full‑time position is eligible for a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the physical, emotional, and financial well‑being of colleagues and their families. The benefits for this position include medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, retirement savings options, wellness programs, and other resources, based on eligibility. 
Additional details about available benefits are provided during the application process and on Benefits Moments .

 
We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on: 10/17/2026 
 
 Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with all federal, state and local laws.
